description:
The seal is gone. `SealSemanticClosure`, `define_semantic_closure`,
`SemanticClosed`, `SemanticReady` and `MaterializeRoot` all grep to ZERO hits in
src/, and jobs/artifact.rs materializes per executable through
`ProductKey::MaterializedExecutable` / `PullOutcome`.

Three types survived the removal with no live user:

    SemanticClosure       src/compiler2/semantic.rs:599
    SemanticClosureSlot   src/compiler2/semantic.rs:887
    SemanticClosureMap    src/compiler2/semantic.rs:892, impl at :1227

## Proof of deadness

    $ grep -rn "SemanticClosure" src/ tests/ | grep -v "src/compiler2/semantic.rs"
    src/compiler2/mod.rs:98:    ... SemanticClosure, SemanticClosureMap, ShapeDemand,

That single re-export is the only outside reference. `SemanticClosureMap::define`
is never called; the struct is never constructed; no `World` field holds one.
The `pub use` from a `pub mod` is what suppresses the dead-code warning.

## Do

Delete all three types and their entries in the `pub use` at
src/compiler2/mod.rs:98.

## Checks

- `grep -rn "SemanticClosure" src/ tests/` returns nothing.
- Full lib + matrix green, zero warnings.

## What the old ticket (fz-463.6) got wrong

It asked to delete the `SealSemanticClosure` job (drive.rs, jobs/root.rs:134-376)
and `define_semantic_closure` (world.rs) -- neither exists -- and to re-enable
and flip two `#[ignore]`d tests,
`compiler2_enum_take_drop_split_seals_without_reseal_runaway` and
`compiler2_transport_input_components_are_schedule_independent`, BOTH of which
have been deleted from the tree. It was also blocked on fz-463.7/.8/.9; the
artifact ladder is already per-executable pull, so that block was stale. What
remains of a P1 epic keystone is a fifteen-line deletion.
title: Delete the orphaned SemanticClosure types left behind by the seal removal
